report:
**Verdict: Shape A — host SDK coordinator with enum operation fixed bridge to the existing CLIs. Reject isolated Pi RPC coord for this proof.**

Why A is buildable now: `tools/pi-worker-task.mjs` already constructs the exact session you need — `createAgentSession` with `noTools:'all'`, one custom tool, `excludeTools:['mcp__*']`, retry/compaction off, empty resource loader, explicit `getModel` plus identity check, and an offline mode that proves bridge/bwrap with `providerPromptStarted:false` (the pre-call gate). Copy that skeleton; swap the tool to a `coordinator_cli` schema `{operation: enum[prepare,launch,read,reconcile], ...scalars}` whose `execute` spawns `node tools/pi-worker-task.mjs|worker-lifecycle.mjs` with argv arrays. No shell, no host bash/default tools, no resources, no MCP, no Pstack.

The coordinator's own tool-call trace must be the proof it chose each step; the harness records but never loops. `run-coordinator-44-native.mjs` auto-runs launch/read — that is exactly the false-proof shape to drop. Assert observed order prepare→launch→read(+reconcile), one launch.

Why not B: no Pi RPC transport, event, or tool-policy plumbing exists in-repo (the worker runs in-process SDK). It adds a runtime framework and risks host default tools/resources/MCP — your exclusions.

Pins: match the untracked `native-coordinator-44-fixture.json` — coordinatorProfileSha (current) separate from workerMethodologySha 37a, input vs target vs model-config vs brief SHAs separate; committed-brief API already `{repo,inputSha,path}`, `briefText` rejected.

State: fresh absence + atomic claim = `mkdir(dir,{recursive:false})` in `launch` (EEXIST fails closed; no second workspace). TotalBudget 1 = harness ledger refuses a second launch even after failure/unknown; CLI errors return to the coordinator, quota consumed once, never retried. Coordinator prompt aborts at 180 s; worker `--timeout-ms 120000` (runner max). Real phase refuses unless precall PASS and offline evidence shows no provider prompt. LunaHigh whole-role override; worker canonical `openai-codex/gpt-6-luna@high`; no fallback.

Smallest rerunnable harness (extend `verify-pi-worker-44.mjs`, offline): unknown operation or shell-like arg rejected before spawn; duplicate attempt-id → nonzero, no directory; second launch → refusal; role token ≠ `worker`, route ≠ `openai-codex/gpt-6-luna@high`, duplicate prepare output → rejected/EEXIST; `getCallableToolNames() === ['coordinator_cli']`. Parent final: `matchesBoundaryControls`, hashes for task/dispatch/terminal, exactly one attempt dir.

Caution: assert the order from recorded events; a coordinator that only calls `read` cannot count as coordinator proof.
